flawed_step: 0014–0016: The claim that f cannot belong to T1 is false. The preceding argument only shows that e is the unique T1-edge crossing between VA and VB; it does not rule out f=e.
counterexample: Take T1=T2 and any e={x,y} in this tree. The unique T2-path from x to y is the edge e itself, so the constructed f equals e and therefore belongs to T1.
assessment_summary: The first definite failure is the unsupported and false assertion at lines 0014–0016. Although this assertion is unnecessary and the later exchange argument still works when f=e, the proof as written contains an invalid step.
